fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/seo/CategoryPages/SeoStructureCategory.cy.js#SEO structure - CategoryPages [tempoTraveller] [ta] — Tempo Traveller TC-SEOS-01: heading structure on Tempo Traveller [ta] matches the stored snapshot
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SEOS-01
**Title:** Heading structure on Tempo Traveller [ta] matches the stored snapshot
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
Open Tempo Traveller (ta) and compare live SEO headings with the snapshot. Allure and artifacts/seo-structure-report.xlsx show expected vs actual so a changed heading can be copied into test data after it is confirmed.

**Expected Result:**
Every stored heading on Tempo Traveller (ta) is still present with the same tag. Extra or missing headings fail the check; order on the page may differ.

**Steps:**
1. Open Tempo Traveller (ta)
2. Expand Read More if the About block is collapsed
3. Compare live headings with the stored snapshot
